snippet.title: KiLLPaKu! // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046510/KiLLPaKu/

A 3D action game where you control Bebe, a gluttonous monster. Aim at the weak points of the fighting "onis" and deal the final blow! Literally, enjoy picking the best parts!

Developed by
Byking RooKIES
